acceptanceCriteria: Shared task terms below an idf floor (or an equivalent commonness bound) do not count toward the two-term minimum; the floor is named in TCP-V0-047 and the analyzer schema is bumped.

Retrieval-bench v2 is re-run against the same baseline as the V1-0186 entry and recall@5 and recall@10 recover to within the baseline's noise while recall@20 and the daily-loop UC-TASK-ORIENTATION treatment case keep their V1-0186 result; the numbers are recorded in BUILD-LOG.
The unrelated-task count with routed rows drops from 3 of 7 to at most 1 of 7 on the recorded task set.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the V1-0186 review (SHOULD-FIX 2). The `instruction-routed` relation in `internal/contextindex/taskcontext.go` routes a passage when it shares any two task terms with the task, with no idf floor, so common repository words (`corvint`, `test`, `spec`) qualify. In the retrieval-bench v2 run recorded for V1-0186, 3 of 7 unrelated tasks received two routed documentation rows ahead of code, which is the likely cause of the accepted recall@10 and recall@5 dips while recall@20 stayed flat.
title: task-context: add an idf floor to instruction-routed passage matching (TCP-V0-047) and re-measure
